Order on Board by Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is in custody in connection with Crime No. 98/2022 registered at Police Station - Chhura, District Gariyaband, CG for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366(A), 376(2)(n), 376(3), 450 IPC, sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act, and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution in short is that the applicant committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix on the promise of marriage.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He further submits that the applicant is in jail since 27.07.2022, and the trial may take some more time for conclusion, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.
4. State counsel opposes the application for bail and submits that looking to the act alleged, the applicant is not entitled for bail.
He however submits that the prosecutrix has been served with the notice.

5. Considering the rival submissions made on behalf of the parties, the facts and circumstances of the case, that the applicant is in jail since 27.07.2022, and that the trial may take some time for conclusion, without commenting on merits of the case
, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the application is allowed and the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before that Court as and when so directed.
